note_en: This text is built around 既…又… "both… and…": 房子虽然不大，却既方便上班，又离地铁站很近 "the apartment isn't big, but it's both convenient for work and close to the subway." English needs "and" only once, while Chinese places 既 and 又 before each of the two predicates, which makes the pairing more balanced and emphatic.
